issues.description: fixed_audio_packet_size has no validation that it aligns with PCM sample width
issues.detail: The param accepts any int with no check that it's a multiple of bytes_per_sample * channels. A misconfigured 641 silently slices samples in half and ships noise. Comments claim 16-bit PCM but nothing enforces the format. Add an assert or raise on StartFrame stating the precondition.

issues.description: Packetization buffer applies to all bytes payloads and weakens serializer postcondition
issues.detail: _write_frame buffers any bytes payload into _audio_send_buffer when the param is set, so non-audio binary payloads get sliced into packet_bytes chunks. Trailing bytes shorter than packet_size are also never flushed at EOS/Cancel, dropping audio at shutdown. Gate on AudioRawFrame and flush (or pad) on stream end.

issues.description: Packetization concern leaks Vonage-specific framing into a generic transport
issues.detail: 20ms@16kHz framing is a property of the Vonage protocol and belongs in VonageFrameSerializer's contract, not in FastAPIWebsocketTransport. Pushing fixed_audio_packet_size up forces every future protocol to renegotiate this knob. A composing PacketizingFrameSerializer wrapper would respect the module boundary and leave the transport interface unchanged.

issues.description: InterruptionFrame clears buffer but in-flight sends and resampler state are not handled
issues.detail: process_frame clears _audio_send_buffer, but websocket send is async and an in-progress chunk can still reach the wire after interruption. The output resampler's filter state from dropped audio is also not reset, producing artifacts on the next utterance. Add a send lock/sequence guard and reset resampler state on interruption.

issues.description: Rename from audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size is a silent breaking change
issues.detail: The param sits on a public dataclass with Optional default None, so existing users of audio_packet_bytes lose packetization with no error — just wrong behavior. Either keep a deprecated alias for one release or flag the break loudly in the changelog.

issues.description: DTMF digit parsing accepts two undocumented payload shapes
issues.detail: deserialize tries message['digit'] then message['dtmf']['digit'] with no spec citation for either. Pick the documented Vonage shape, treat the other as a compatibility shim with a TODO, or remove the speculative branch. Defensive 'try both' code hides protocol drift and survives forever.

synthesis.summary: The Vonage serializer is small and roughly correct, but the new fixed_audio_packet_size buffering on FastAPIWebsocketTransport has real problems. It applies to any bytes payload (not just audio), drops trailing audio at shutdown, races with InterruptionFrame, and pushes a Vonage-specific framing concern into a generic transport when it belongs in a composing serializer wrapper. The param accepts misaligned sizes with no validation despite comments asserting PCM16, and the rename from audio_packet_bytes is a quiet breaking change. NEEDS-WORK before merge.
